SELECT sys10_file_id AS file_id , apr.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr.dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_name , apr.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , f_cdnm('AprInOutTypeCode', apr.apr01_inout_cd, apr.apr01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS inout_name , apr.apr01_title AS apr_title , sys10_file_nm AS file_name , apr.apr01_note AS note , emp01_kor_nm AS emp_name FROM sys10_file INNER JOIN apr01_appr apr ON apr.apr01_appr_id = sys10_parent_id INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree dcr ON apr.apr01_class_tree_id = dcr.dcr01_class_tree_id AND dcr.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN emp01_person ON apr.apr01_reg_emp_id = emp01_person_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr03_org_auth ON apr.apr01_class_tree_id = dcr03_class_tree_id AND dcr03_org_code_id = #{c.orgId} LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr04_emp_auth ON apr.apr01_class_tree_id = dcr04_class_tree_id AND dcr04_person_id = #{c.empId}
WHERE 1=1 AND apr01_company_id = #{c.companyId}
AND ( COALESCE(dcr04_retrieve_yn, dcr03_retrieve_yn, 'false') = 'true' OR ( #{c.empId} IN ( SELECT apr04_step_emp_id FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr.apr01_appr_id ) ) OR ( #{c.empId} IN ( SELECT apr13_person_id FROM apr13_person_auth WHERE apr13_appr_id = apr.apr01_appr_id ) ) )
AND apr01_status_cd = '30' AND f_trunc(apr01_reg_date) BETWEEN COALESCE(#{c.startDate}, to_date('19000101', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND COALESCE(#{c.endDate}, to_date('29991231', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND UPPER(CONCAT( apr01_title , sys10_file_nm , apr01_note , f_emp_kor_nm(emp01_person_id) )) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText})
AND dcr.dcr01_class_tree_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree_down(dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, dcr01_parent_tree_id, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a.dcr01_class_tree_id], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_class_tree_id = #{c.classTreeId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS varchar), 15, '0')), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_tree_down b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id FROM dcr_tree_down a )
ORDER BY f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr.dcr01_class_tree_id) , apr01_reg_date , apr01_title , sys10_file_nm

SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_name , apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , f_cdnm('AprInOutTypeCode', apr01_appr.apr01_inout_cd, apr01_appr.apr01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS inout_name , apr01_inout_cd AS inout_code , apr01_title AS apr_title , emp01_kor_nm AS emp_name , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = apr01_appr_id AND COALESCE(sys10_title_yn, 'false') = 'false' ) AS file_count , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = apr01_appr_id AND COALESCE(sys10_title_yn, 'false') = 'true' ) AS title_count FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON apr01_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id AND dcr01_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN emp01_person ON apr01_reg_emp_id = emp01_person_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr03_org_auth ON apr01_class_tree_id = dcr03_class_tree_id AND dcr03_org_code_id = #{c.orgId} LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr04_emp_auth ON apr01_class_tree_id = dcr04_class_tree_id AND dcr04_person_id = #{c.empId}
WHERE 1=1 AND apr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND apr01_status_cd = '30' AND f_trunc(apr01_reg_date) BETWEEN COALESCE(#{c.startDate}, to_date('19000101', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND COALESCE(#{c.endDate}, to_date('29991231', 'yyyyMMdd'))
AND ( COALESCE(dcr04_retrieve_yn, dcr03_retrieve_yn, 'false') = 'true' OR ( #{c.empId} IN ( SELECT apr04_step_emp_id FROM apr04_appr_step WHERE apr04_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) ) OR ( #{c.empId} IN ( SELECT apr13_person_id FROM apr13_person_auth WHERE apr13_appr_id = apr01_appr_id ) ) )
AND dcr01_class_tree_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree_down(dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, dcr01_parent_tree_id, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || a.dcr01_class_tree_id], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_class_tree_id = #{c.classTreeId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar), 10, '0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS varchar), 15, '0')), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_tree_down b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND a.dcr01_use_yn = 'true' AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE #{c.typeCode} AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id FROM dcr_tree_down a )
AND UPPER(CONCAT( apr01_title , f_emp_kor_nm(emp01_person_id) , f_get_emptrans(emp01_person_id, apr01_reg_date::date, 'org_code_nm') , apr01_note )) LIKE UPPER(#{c.searchText}) ORDER BY f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) , apr01_reg_date , apr01_title
